evals.name: prespecified-bounce-suppression
evals.prompt:
spec out KAT-1470 for me. ticket already has AC on it:

---
KAT-1470 — Suppress sending to hard-bounced addresses
When the email provider reports a hard bounce for an address, stop sending to that address for that SMB account.
AC:
- Given an address has a recorded hard bounce for account A, when a campaign send targets it, then no message is queued and the skip is recorded.
- Given the same address on account B with no bounce, when a campaign send targets it, then the message is queued normally.
- Given a hard bounce arrives for an address with no prior record, when it is processed, then a suppression record is created for that account.
---

repo is email.
evals.expected_output: few questions asked (AC already settled), AC carried forward not rewritten, non-goals covering soft bounce and unsubscribe, [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] on suppression-record retention, notes that no suppression code exists today after checking
